acme-app: hey @jess we're getting intermittent 400s from /v1/rerank since this morning. small subset of requests fail with validation errors. example response and curl below.

acme-app: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"items":[{"id":"q1","query":"foo","candidates":[],"top_k":"5"}]}'
```

acme-app: response:
```json
{"status":400,"error":"validation_error","message":"items[0].candidates must be a non-empty array"}
```

jess (Support): thanks — can you confirm SDK/version and whether any proxy modifies the body? is candidates intentionally empty or filtered?

acme-app: android-client 2.3.0. We batch candidate lists and sometimes they are empty after a filter step. top_k used to be an int; noticed here it's a string sometimes.

sam (Support Eng): hmmm android 2.3.0 had an envelope bug where numbers in small payloads were stringified. that would hit our strict schema. can you also share the raw bytes (curl as above) when it fails?

acme-app: pasted raw curl above. This happens ~0.6% of requests end up with empty candidates and top_k as string.

jess (Support): reproduce notes — validated locally: when candidates === [] we return 400 with message 'must be non-empty array'. also if top_k is string, schema validator throws a 400 with 'top_k must be integer'. they can be two separate root causes.

ingrid (Eng Runtime): assigning a quick fix: we can improve validation error clarity and tolerate numeric strings for top_k for now. will push a small change to map numeric strings -> int to reduce immediate flakes. empty candidates we should keep as an explicit error (rerank requires candidates). I'll open a PR and roll to staging.

deploy-bot: Deployed validation-fallback/topk-string-coerce to staging at 2024-06-21T15:12:00Z :rocket:

jess (Support): thanks team. acme-app — can you test against staging and send the failing request id if you still see 400s? we'll keep this ticket open until verified. :thumbsup:

acme-app: will test and report repro id 0b7a7e9f. thanks!
